body.name: WKDClass
body.def: \(\mathcal W_{\mathrm{WKD}}\) is the class of laws generated by recursive additive-error structural equations \(Z_v=f_v(Z_{\operatorname{pa}(v)})+\epsilon_v\) with mutually independent centered coordinate errors, with order identifiability supplied by nonlinear structural functions or by linear non-Gaussian errors, as in Wang--Kolar--Drton
